question: ¿Qué agencias tienen más de un tercio de su monto en contratos con un solo grupo empresario, sumando todas las empresas de ese grupo?

attempts.query:
with tot as (
  select awarding_agency, sum(amount) total
  from usaspending.contract group by awarding_agency
), grp as (
  select c.awarding_agency, sg.group_id, sum(c.amount) monto
  from usaspending.contract c
  join proveedores.supplier_group sg on sg.supplier_uei = c.recipient_uei
  group by c.awarding_agency, sg.group_id
)
select distinct t.awarding_agency
from tot t join grp g on g.awarding_agency = t.awarding_agency
where g.monto > t.total / 3.0
order by 1

answer: Court Services and Offender Supervision Agency
